Name: Flirtier Alex Revamp
Author: sunshineydays
Description:
Alex, but a bit more flirty! Modifies most vanilla dialogue and all events. It's not too radical of a change.

I've done my best to test all dialogue and events, but I might have missed issues. Let me know of any bugs!

[b]
IMPORTANT - Portrait Info[/b]
This mod uses a custom Alex portrait option, a wink. A vanilla-match version is enabled by default. I specifically had in mind my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24234]Seasonal Alex Revised[/url] mod, though. [b]To use with Seasonal Alex Revised, uncheck "VanillaPortraitStyle" for this mod in Generic Mod Config Menu. [/b]It'll work after that.


[b]Modding[/b]
If you'd like to edit other Alex portrait mods to have a wink the way I have:
[list]
[*]delete the white square in the last portrait position
[*]copy and paste Alex's happy portrait to that position
[*]copy and paste his blushing portrait open eye on top of the closed one
[/list]
And if any other dialogue mod wants to use the wink portrait, the reference is $11![b]

Notes: [/b]
[list]
[*]Uses the 1.6 gender dialogue command to be ready for gender-neutral mods
[*]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2557]Flirtier Alex Dialogue Overhaul for Content Patcher[/url] by Wumbuzz
[/list]
[b]Future Goals:
[/b][list]
[*]make an option to turn off wink portrait for dialogue
[*]add additional dialogue for variety, especially for marriage
[*]put in i18n format
[*]put together a better header image
[/list]
